notes.title: Tanklike Update 0.7
notes.content:
[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Steam achievements
[*] Unlockable guns
[*] New rooms
[*] Booster pad, available in level editor
[*] Controls reference in pause menu
[*] More and improved SFX
[*] Black bars at the edge of rooms
[*] Mouseover tooltips for stats and abilities
[*] A judgy little emoticon
[*] One whole new ability
[/list]

[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved the title screen
[*] Improved some rooms
[*] Minor change to the cost of abilities and extra lives
[*] Improved the Missile's homing capabilities
[*] Tanks that die from fire will some some fire of their own behind
[*] Player stats have been moved to the corners of the screen
[*] Kills shown at the end of a run will scroll
[*] The Start button on a controller will now start the game if everyone is ready
[*] One way shields in the level editor are easier to manage
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fire SFX no longer continues to play when the game is paused
[*] Dying while choosing a reward will properly remove the reward options
[*] Fixed a performance issue with some particle effects
[*] Enemy turrets no longer occasionally effected by some mystery colliders
[*] The Gauss Laser ability destroys bullets as it should
[*] The Speed Boost ability damages enemies as it should
[*] The Barrel Drop ability works again
[*] Fixed a bug that stopped ghost players from respawning
[*] The one way shield and booster pad properly deselect in the level editor
[/list]

notes.title: Tanklike Releases on Steam Early Access July 1st
notes.content:
Hello! Thank you for your interest in Tanklike :) We’ll be releasing on Steam Early Access July 1st 2020.

Tanklike is inspired by the fun we had playing Wii Play Tanks back in the day. Remember that game? This is our twist on those mechanics. We got stat boosts, abilities, custom rooms, catchy tunes, friendly fire, actual fire, and some wacky plans for the future.

Hope you get the chance to play! We greatly appreciate any feedback you might have. We hang out on [url=https://discord.gg/qQaWeDn]Discord [/url]and Tanklike’s [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1302550/discussions/]discussion forums[/url].
